title: Antique Atlas 4 TFC
description: Resource pack adding support for TerraFirmaCraft biomes in Antique Atlas 4.
body:
# Antique Atlas 4 TFC respack

Resource pack adding support for TerraFirmaCraft biomes in Antique Atlas 4.

Maps existing AA4 textures to TFC biomes, does not add new tiles.

Tested on Antique Atlas 4 3.1.2+1.21 and TerraFirmaCraft 4.2.4.

## Caveats

TFC biomes encode landform, not climate. So the mapping is conservative, trying to avoid giving wrong information.

```
  ┌───────────┬─────────────────────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  Family   │             Example biomes              │                 Textures                  │
  ├───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────┤
  │ Water     │ ocean*, all lakes, river                │ feature/water                             │
  ├───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────┤
  │ Mountains │ mountains, old/oceanic/collisional,     │ cliffs → stony → jagged peak              │
  │           │ glacially_carved                        │                                           │
  ├───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────┤
  │ Volcanic  │ volcanic_mountains,                     │ + feature/lava crater at peak             │
  │           │ active_shield_volcano                   │                                           │
  ├───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────┤
  │ Glaciated │ ice_sheet_mountains, glaciated_*        │ snow_cliffs → frozen → snow peak          │
  ├───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────┤
  │ Badlands  │ badlands, mesas, buttes, hoodoos        │ existing terracotta tiles                 │
  ├───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────┤
  │ Karst     │ tower_karst, shilin, doline, cenote     │ mapped by shape to                        │
  │           │                                         │ highlands/plateau/canyons/hills           │
  ├───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────┤
  │ Shores    │ shore, rocky_shores, embayments         │ beach / stony_shore                       │
  └───────────┴─────────────────────────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────┘
  ```
